citizen.name: Rune Underhill
citizen.learned: Rune grew up in a small coastal village and moved to Vesper to take care of his elderly grandmother.
citizen.lifestyle: Rune spends his days tending to the gardens around town and his evenings reading books on botany.
citizen.currently: Rune is worried about the recent changes in the tides and how they might affect the gardens.

relationships: Rune and Tobiah often chat about the weather and its effects on their respective crafts.
Rune buys supplies from Wren for his gardening work.
Rune and Petra often discuss the latest town news and gossip.
Rune and Emmet have a shared love of the sea and often go fishing together.
